Initial release of skill jobber-fpx for accessing Jobber Client Hub from the shell without MCP:

- Allows fetching appointment, quote, invoice, and work request data for Jobber customers using @fetchproxy/cli (`fpx`) and the Transporter extension in Chrome.
- Uses your existing, signed-in Chrome tab to bypass Cloudflare protection; no server-side method or cookie access required.
- Supports read-only access to your Jobber customer portal data in scriptable JSON form via a provided parser.
- Strongly protects your unique hub URL as a credential; each vendor provides a separate hub.
- Includes clear error handling, exit codes, and ready-to-use recipes for common queries.
- No write capabilities or file downloads; payments and form submissions are not supported.
